picks.headline: Figma's Workflow Lab: keeping canvas and code in sync when agents write the front end
picks.excerpt: Coding agents are reshaping how developers build, but they're only as good as the context they're given. Figma walks through a concrete workflow for moving between design and code with agents without losing design intent.
picks.rationale: The most actionable item in the pool — a named, repeatable design-to-code-to-design loop a team can adopt tomorrow, straight from the tool most of them already live in.

picks.headline: Figma rebuilt its AI-impact study with AI — and the index hit 62 of 100, nearly double 2024
picks.excerpt: Figma revisits the study it started in 2024 on how AI reshapes design and product development, and this time uses AI to run the research itself. The post digs into what design orgs can actually measure about AI's effect on their work.
picks.rationale: Replaces the 80 Level Tripo item, which today's games section already carries; gives design orgs a concrete measurement frame — a 0–100 index across six dimensions, plus the AI research stack behind it.

picks.headline: AIA puts an AI assistant inside architecture's contract-document workflow
picks.excerpt: AIA Contract Documents launched an AI Assistant for the industry-standard contracts architects and designers work from daily, alongside naming a new CTO — a sign of AI moving into the paperwork layer of design practice.
picks.rationale: A concrete launch inside the industry-standard paperwork designers sign against — AI moving past the canvas into the contractual layer of practice.

picks.headline: Google's 'Listening area' turns Android XR glasses into a spatial AI translation UI
picks.excerpt: Google is reportedly testing a 'Listening area' mode for Live Translate on Android XR — a spatial interaction pattern that could become the headline feature of its upcoming smart glasses.
picks.rationale: A genuinely new spatial interaction pattern — selecting who the AI listens to by where they stand — and a preview of the interface vocabulary for glasses.

picks.headline: Meta's Muse Image lands on Vercel AI Gateway — one key for image generation in prototypes
picks.excerpt: Meta's Muse Image model is now callable through Vercel AI Gateway with a single API key: no provider account, automatic fallbacks, spend tracking and traces on every request. It makes image generation trivial to drop into a design prototype.
picks.rationale: Removes the account-and-key friction that keeps image generation out of prototypes — a designer can wire real generated imagery into a v0 build the same afternoon.
